patch_list: Hides sponsored ads and Google Ads. Also disables Microsoft Clarity analytics.
Hides the Pur ad-free subscription option from the settings menu.
Remove tracking parameters from share URLs
Strips UTM tracking parameters from URLs shared via the in-app share function.
